title: The Last Dinosaur of the Congo with David Choe
description: VICE's Congo excerpt follows Choe's childish sense of adventure into a search for the reported Mokele-mbembe, through expert and local testimony, disorienting jungle travel with guides and paranoid jokes about sorcerers reading his mind.
